text_block_list.text:
Um, Тренер? I wanted to celebrate
Valentine's
Day with you, but...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Valentine's Day should be a fun day, but
Super
Creek seems awfully down.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I ask her if she forgot to bring her
chocolates.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'd never forget something like that.
I brought
the chocolates I made, but...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: That's not it...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Will you try one for me?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: I pop one into my mouth.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The flavor of heavenly chocolate
blossoms in my
mouth—a true Super
Creek masterpiece.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Does it taste okay?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: I could die happy right now.

text_block_list.text: What?! Please don't!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I don't see any problems with the flavor,
so why
does she seem so upset?
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
You see, I put my heart and soul into
making
these chocolates. But when they
were done, it hit
me...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
What kind of chocolates are these
exactly?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
There are all sorts of chocolates, right?
You give
some out of romance, others
out of friendship...
or even obligation.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
But I can't tell which feelings I poured
into these.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: Surely they're not... out of obligation?

text_block_list.text:
Absolutely not! If I had to pick the most

appropriate kind, then I guess it'd be
romance,
but...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I don't know how to answer, since that's
not the
kind of relationship an
Umamusume has with her
trainer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hmm, if I really had to put a label on my

chocolates, then...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Our relationship is hard to define, so
maybe
describing them as "ambiguous"
makes sense.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
You're right, but the thought of them
being
ambiguous is a little sad.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
How about "ambiguously special
chocolates?"
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness. I feel a little better
now.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
It makes sense. We have a relationship
where we
can't really pin down what's
special about it.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Romantic chocolates are ones that you
can only
give to someone you like,
right?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
The word "like" doesn't even come close
to
describing how I feel about you.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
You have been and always will be
irreplaceable
to me.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I don't know what to call them, but
reserving
them for an irreplaceable
partner only seems a bit
heavy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After pondering for a while, I suggest
that there's
no need to label them at all.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But that's just plain old chocolate then!
Are you
sure?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Hmm, but maybe you're right. Maybe
they don't
need a label...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Words can't really describe the
relationship we
have.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
It's something that others don't
understand, but
we do.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Heh... hehehe. We're silly for
overthinking it.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'm sure you must be hungry now
after all
that thinking.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
They're the most unique chocolates in
the world,
so go ahead and eat up!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик smiles and watches me
enjoy the
chocolates. There's a hint of
something special in
them that makes
them all the more delicious.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The chocolates taste like a genuine
bond, with a
sweetness no regular
couple could dream of
experiencing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
